title: Fun Banquet
paragraphs: “Sadina, please take care of the village children.”
“Okay~. Are you sure I shouldn’t go out and fight?”
Big sister’s question was met with a nod from her friend.
“Please take care of Raphtalia-chan. I think this is the time for her to protect the village.”
“I see… understood.”
Big sister nodded and looked out over the village with Raphtalia.
“It’s okay. The heroes are here, and I’m here too. I won’t let what happened last time happen again. This time, we’ll overcome it.”
Big sister smiled gently as she lifted Raphtalia up from behind. …Time was running out.
“Alright, we’re going.”
“This time, we’ll win for sure!”

The slaves, showing their determination even in the village, raised their voices, and Father and the others waved to those staying behind. Then, as the time arrived, our surroundings shifted in an instant, and the wave began. As expected, it was a wave near Ryute Village.
“That’s the wave…”
“This time, we’ll definitely overcome it! Heroes, let’s go!”
Hearing big sister’s friend’s voice, Father and the others nodded.
“Let’s do this!”
“Yeah!”

To put it simply, it was a landslide victory. Normally, with me and the other heroes, the wave could be crushed effortlessly, but since this was a chance for Keel and our friends to redeem themselves and for Father and the others to gain experience, I held back a little while fighting the wave’s monsters. If the wave is stopped too quickly, the people won’t truly understand its threat. So, I intentionally let a few monsters slip away to give the residents a taste of fear. I arrived on the scene just as appropriate screams and flames began to rise.
“We did it! Woooooo!”
After taking down the Dimensional Chimera and closing the wave’s rift, Keel let out a victorious roar.
“Yay!”
Big sister’s friend raised her right hand in triumph while riding on Kou’s back. Kou was also overjoyed, bouncing around happily.
“Yay! Kou did his best. I wonder if Rifana and Raphtalia will praise me?”
Big sister and her friend seem to have become very dear friends to Kou.
“They’ll definitely praise you. Come on, let’s head back.”
“What should we do with this chimera’s corpse?”
“I’ve already sent word to Mother. The kingdom will handle the nearby monster cleanup with Éclair’s assistance.”
Fiancée explained things amidst the victorious mood. By the way, she had been fighting alongside Sakura-chan. In her adult form, Sakura-chan seems to prefer dual-wielding.
“The heroes are the ones who’ll be using it, right?”
“Yeah. Why don’t we take this chimera’s corpse back as proof of our victory? We can add it to the weapons later.”
“That’s true. I’m sure Keel and the others would want it as a trophy.”
“Yeah, it’s good to show off that we won.”

With that, the chimera’s corpse was loaded onto a cart and carried by the filolials, led by Yuki-chan and the others. Though we returned to the village for the time being, we were invited to the castle for a victory celebration later that night.

…Come to think of it, isn’t this the first time all the heroes have gathered and enjoyed themselves at Melromarc’s castle? Last time, we ended up fleeing somehow, and the time before that, Itsuki dueled Father. Even before that, we didn’t participate in Melromarc’s wave at all. Thinking about it now, it’s quite moving.
“It’s truly delightful that the outcome this time was different from the previous report of damages.”
The queen was giving a speech as the representative during the victory celebration.
“I believe this is thanks to the Four Cardinal Heroes, their companions… and the unity of the people who stood together against the wave.”

A victory celebration held at the castle with the villagers who overcame the wave. It’s not that there aren’t any remnants of the Three Hero Church here, but I can feel the change in the air at this moment. For this night alone, I prayed that no misfortune would befall Father, and I feel my wish has been granted at this victory celebration. It’s been a long road, looking back.
“Naofumi-sama, it’s a feast!”
“Brother, brother! This is my first time at such a fancy party!”
“Ahaha, everyone can enjoy themselves however they like.”
Big sister’s friend, her eyes darting between the many dishes, began eating with big sister and Kou.
“Oh? This is good liquor.”

Big sister also sipped her drink, savoring the taste. Father is here, and big sister is here. Well, big sister still feels a little young, but unlike in the first world, they’re all together now, enjoying the victory celebration at Melromarc. Afterward, we returned to the village through the portal and slept soundly. The next day, of course, I timed it just right and went to the monster merchant to buy more filolials. Starting with Luna-chan, I gathered both familiar and unfamiliar ones. Though, I’ve pretty much covered everything the monster merchant has by now.
Oh! I’ve found Luna-chan!
However… as expected, Filo-tan is still nowhere to be found. When I returned to the village, I showed Keel Luna-chan’s egg.
“What is it, spear bro?”
“This is Luna-chan.”
“Hmm.”
“What are you doing?”
At that moment, Father arrived.
“This is Luna-chan’s egg. I went to the monster merchant this morning and bought it.”
“Ah… so Motoyasu, you’re already preparing for the next wave.”
Oh? Father seems to have misunderstood. I simply bought the filolial because I wanted to, nothing more.
But… well, there’s no need to correct him. Father doesn’t seem opposed to increasing the number of filolials anyway.
“Strengthening our new forces is a good thing. The village kids are steadily getting stronger too.”
“I’ll do my best.”
“Raphatalia-chan is also about to learn magic. She’s learning really fast.”
“Oh? Is that so?”
Since the education of the village’s slaves is mainly handled by Father, Fiancée, and big sister, I don’t know much about the details.

“Yeah. After hearing the stories at the victory celebration and about the wave, even the kids who stayed behind seem motivated now. Half-baked skills are dangerous, but if they’re properly watched over, it should be fine, right?”
“I don’t think there’s any problem.”
When it comes to training, the system in place is solid. In fact, I can’t imagine a better team to oversee their growth.

“And about Raphatalia-chan… according to Melty-chan and others knowledgeable about magic, she’s good at creating illusions. Maybe because she feels frustrated about just staying behind, she stayed up all night trying to learn it yesterday.”
Father yawned sleepily.
“Is it still the night crying?”

“…Well, yeah. It’s less frequent, but sometimes, if no one’s around… So, Motoyasu, I’ve already disassembled the chimera’s corpse and used it for weapon materials. Should I use the leftovers as food for the new filolials?”
“Please do.”
And so, I began raising Luna-chan.
“That said… Kou and Kuro-chan seem to have gotten hungry in the middle of the night and gnawed on it quite a bit… There might not be much left to use.”
“Brother, brother! Let’s use it as a mat! A trophy to prove we hunted it! We could hang it on the roof too!”
“That’s wild. So, there’s not much left to use, huh…”
“Either way, we’ll go hunting and get more food.”

We’re also harvesting plenty of vegetables from the bioplant’s fields. I’m sure we can manage somehow. After the wave, I spent the next few days raising Luna-chan and the other filolials. Meanwhile, Father and the others continued to raise the slaves’ levels, defeating dangerous monsters across Melromarc and even traveling to other countries to subjugate monsters, with big sister’s help. Of course, I made sure that Ren and Itsuki understood the importance of maintaining the ecosystem.
